2025-06-22.riddle: I’m sharp and tiny, used in thread, I have an eye but no real head. I help to make your clothes complete— What am I?

2025-06-23.riddle: I’m round and bright, I shine at night, Reflecting beams from far-off light. You’ll find me changing shape with time— What am I?
2025-06-23.hint: I glow softly in the dark sky.

2025-06-24.riddle: I’m carried on shoulders or in a hand, I shade your face across the land. I open wide when the sun is bright— What am I?
2025-06-24.hint: I also help when rain arrives.

2025-06-25.riddle: I’m square or round, I help you eat, I sit beneath your favorite treat. Without me, meals would be a mess— What am I?
2025-06-25.hint: I hold your dinner but I’m not a tray.

2025-06-26.riddle: I’m not alive, but I can grow, I don’t have lungs, but I need air though. I don’t have a mouth, but water kills me— What am I?

2025-06-27.riddle: I help you build with colors bright, I click and stack both left and right. From castles high to cars that roll— What am I?

2025-06-28.riddle: I’m cold and sweet, I come in scoops, You eat me quickly before I droop. In cones or cups, I’m a summer win— What am I?
2025-06-28.hint: I melt if you wait too long.

2025-06-29.riddle: I mark your place where you last read, Between the pages, where I’m spread. I’m thin and flat and love a book— What am I?
2025-06-29.hint: I help you remember your spot.

2025-06-30.riddle: I light your path when roads are dark, I beam ahead like a glowing spark. I’m mounted to cars to help you see— What am I?
